Name: Desaturated Couches and Armchairs
Author: SageButBinx
Description:
Using Alternative Textures, you can now change the yellow, blue, and green armchairs and couches to *slighty* desaturated versions.

Plz note that these are only VERY SLIGHTLY recoloured. It's supposed to be virtually unnoticeable, but still kinder on the eyes. 

Alternative textures MANDATORY <3
